title: A Wizard of Earthsea
author: Ursula K. Le Guin
summary: A proud, gifted boy from a small island is sent to a school for wizards, where his arrogance leads him to release something terrible into the world. He then spends years trying to put right what he has done.
readIf: you want a short, wise fantasy about pride, names and responsibility, written with great clarity.
skipIf: you want an action-packed read or lavish worldbuilding, since it is spare and quiet.

pairings.reason: Another story of a brilliant young magic student, far longer and more elaborate.
A comparably classic, concise fantasy with a similarly storytelling feel.
Same author and the same thoughtful, humane style, applied to science fiction.
